name: Solano County Crisis Line
description: Solano County Behavioral Health's 24/7 Mobile Crisis team (operated by Pacific Clinics) helps people in an urgent mental health crisis by phone, at home, or in the community.
fullDescription: Solano County Behavioral Health's 24/7 Mobile Crisis team (operated by Pacific Clinics) helps people in an urgent mental health crisis by phone, at home, or in the community.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24/7/365 mobile crisis hotline
- Phone support, de-escalation, and safety planning
- In-person response at home or in the community when needed
- Transportation to the Crisis Stabilization Unit or emergency room if necessary
- Anyone can call, regardless of insurance
howToGetIt: Call Mobile Crisis at 707-806-0866 anytime for an urgent mental health crisis, such as suicidal thoughts. For non-urgent mental health and substance use services, call the Behavioral Health Access Line at 800-547-0495. You can also call or text 988.
keywords: Solano County, crisis line, mobile crisis, mental health crisis, suicide prevention, Crisis Stabilization Unit
